issues.on_page: Grants and contributions 91,359; SoA (p2-3): capital grants and contributions 80,207 (general government) + operating grants 11,152 (environment and leisure)
issues.issue: Source isn't stated; the 80,207 capital grant may be a government grant (intergovernmental/federal) rather than a donation. The same applies to detail[5], detail[22] and detail[29].

Repayment of federal CARES Act funds (about 23% of General Fund spending) is recorded as general government spending with a guessed object. It's as printed, but a person may want to decide how a grant repayment is treated.
The schedule prints only 'Capital outlay' with no object, so 'equipment purchases' is a guess ('not itemized' would be neutral)
